reviews.x: I love love love this dye. I left it on for 4 hours as I always do with any dye. This is the most virbrant and long lasting dye that i have used. I wash my hair 2 times a week at most with sulfate free products. I also use a lot of dry shampoo. Ive had it for about 2 months now and the color it has faded into is just as pretty. Hands down the best dye Ive used and I will never go back to a different brand.

I love the smell of aritic fox color.  This was perfect shade of green that I wanted.  This brand does not bleed color with each wash like manic panic and splat dyes.  This is smaller bottle. For long hair I would get a bigger size of this color or multiple bottles. It does not dry out hair. It conditioned my hair well! I did bleach my hair before using for a more vibrant color.

reviews.t: Great product. The green is super vibrant
reviews.x: Great product. The green is super vibrant. Iv been dying my hair with a mix of different blues and greens from all different brands for a while now. I tried Arctic fox after reading that it has lasting power and it did! This picture is probably 5 or 6 weeks after dying my hair where as most dyes my hair would be gray already.

I went real camping, out in the woods for a week, the day after this was applied. And i hadnt taken a shower yet to wash my hair, by time i was done camping the color had almost completely faded from my hair. The previous time id used this we did not bleach my hair and by time we went to dye my hair again it was completely no sign left of dye in my hair. So maybe my hair doesnt like this dye but this is the issues i had.

reviews.t: Made me feel like a Boss A$$ B!tc#
reviews.x: As always, Arctic Fox has awesome products. I mixed 8oz phantom green and 4oz aquamarine to create a striking green color that faded to an aqua/teal. It lasted about 3 weeks before I needed to dye again.

I ordered the green after hearing such good things about arctic fox. And getting great results from their purple rain... But this was the biggest haircolor let down I have ever had. My hair was lightened and everything mind u, ideal circumstances for the product. Barely a hint if green on silvery blonde hair. And what little green I got I doubt will last more than a day or two. Some arctic fox colors may work wonders. But I feel like I wasted my money ordering this and time attempting to use it

I LOVE artic fox. I used to use pravana but holy crap did that stuff transfer and bleed like crazy. Arctic fox lasts in bleached hair and doesn't bleed half as much. IF YOU WANT IT TO LAST IN YOUR HAIR 1. Do not shampoo your hair for at least 48 hours after rinsing out the dye. 2. ONLY wash your hair with cold water. And I mean COLD. 3. Do not wash more than once or twice weekly. 4. Use dye friendly products.  This color turned out way more vivid than I expected, I love it!

I've been dying my hair green for about 3 years now. I usually use Pravana, but have been trying out new dyes over the last year or so hoping to find one that didnt bleed as bad. I had high hopes for Arctic Fox, as a lot of people I've talked with swear by it. Sadly, it didnt work well for my hair. Prior to dying it, my roots had grown out about 3 inches and my bleached hair had faded to a mellow green shade. I bleached my roots to platinum and gave it a few day to rest before using Phantom Gree

reviews.t: Everything washed out like it was never in there in the first place
reviews.x: Did not color my bleached hair AT ALL. Everything washed out like it was never in there in the first place.

reviews.t: Green is a little harder to upkeep.
reviews.x: Artic Fox is and always will be my go to brand of multicolour semi-permanent hair colour. After years of damage (and we’re talking about 14 years here) from using Manic Panic on my hair, I discovered Arctic and it’s been so good to me. However, green is a bit of an upkeep process, no fault of the brand. Otherwise, it smells good, it’s nice on hair, and always brings out stunning colours. For the green specifically, you’ll have to get other dyes along with this one, as without any additional hair

reviews.t: Smells amazing. Only works on light colored hair
reviews.x: I love it! Omg it smells AMAZING! just as FYI, my color is equal parts blue and green. It turned my brown roots black (which I actually bought black because that was my original plan). I followed the directions. It said best results cover in plastic and use heat. I didn’t use heat but I did cover in plastic. It did dye EVERYTHING. My face turned a little green, my hands were green for awhile. My bathtub is still green. But the color is great and the smell is amazing

reviews.t: The color was good, a nice green
reviews.x: This is more translucent a dye than say manic panic.  It took more to cover my hair, too.  The color was good, a nice green, close to the photo's color, but it did not last long.  it quickly started to fade to more of a yellow at the roots and blue at the ends.  I suspect that sunlight may make it fade faster, much like some manic panic colors wash out faster after UV exposure.

Didn’t really work on my sons hair the first time. So we bought stuff to lighten it. After that it came out the perfect green look he wanted. (He’s 5 in case you’re wondering). It looked good for about 2 weeks prior to our vacation. A week out in the sun completely took all the color out. So just know you’ll be redoing it fairly regularly.

This product did NOT work for me. I wanted to try a new brand of dye and it didn’t adhere to my hair at all despite it being lightened quite a bit. It was patchy and just impossible to smoothly and evenly dye. I went back to something I’ve used before to cover it and wasted more money.

LOVE Artic Fox. I wish there was a permanent one and not just a semi permanent, but still love everything about Artic Fox. It smells amazing and hasn't stained any thing in my rent house! Also love the deep green. 😍
I love the color I only did a test strand because I am gonna be mixing it with aquamarine to make an emerald green. Very excited to have my hair dyed again.
Lasts for MONTHS. I tried other brands but Arctic Fox is he best in terms of color payoff and longetivity.
Was referred to this company as the best. Didnt even last a week

reviews.t: Color was neon colored was looking for the green on the bottle
reviews.x: Color was neon colored was looking for the green on the bottle
I like the dye. Over turquoise it just makes turquoise darker.

I thought I give this brand a chance after hearing good things about them from others. I used Arctic Fox (Phantom Green) in comparison with Lunar Tides (Juniper Green).  Unfortunately, I am not convinced and will not buy this brand of dye again.  +PROS+ + Cool bottle design + Easy to use  - CONS - -The SMELL is horrible, like a cheap super sweet bubble gum. It stinks. Literally. - The color isn't as shiny, deep, and vibrant as other brands - it washes out SO fast! I try to wash my colorful hair

We used two colors, black and green. Both were applied to lightened hair. The black worked fantastic covered beautifully, the green covered alright but not as vibrant as we were hoping for. Will try a second application to see if that helps. Product sure does smell better than the rest will buy again even if two applications are needed for some colors. Disclaimer: we did not use the arctic fox lightener/ bleach. It was done prior to knowing about this product.

Worst green hair dye I've ever used. I have done hair with this three different times. All times the hair was completely bleached and lightened. I left the color in for and hour or more in one case and when it rinsed out with no shampoo the hair was completely blonde again didnt take AT ALL. Don't get me wrong I have loved artic fix for a while but lately it has not been up to expectations in any way. Very disappointed.

The color was absolutely gorgeous at first and it smelled amazing, like I wish I could buy a candle that smelled like this dye. But it didn't take to some spots and faded really bad after just 1 wash. Now my hair is a light dull grassy green and the spots where it didn't take are very obvious. I also have to point out that if you do decide to buy this mix it up really well or else you might get some blue patches.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the green shade vibrant and long-lasting, praising its staying power compared to other brands.
Several reviewers report the color faded or washed out quickly, sometimes within weeks or after sun exposure.
Some reviewers say the dye did not adhere well or work at all on their hair, even when lightened.
Reviewers note the product smells good and does not dry out hair.
Some reviewers mention green requires more upkeep and fades faster than other shades.
